KARIANN JOURNAL

Privacy.

What to know about the journal’s data and links.

No Kariann account needed

The journal has no registration, forms or newsletter. Its code adds no advertising trackers, audience analytics or local storage. Language switching uses links between pages.

Images and videos

This edition’s images are served with the site. In older guides, a YouTube player loads only when you press play. This connects to YouTube, whose own privacy practices then apply.

When you visit a shop

Clicking a purchase address opens the retailer’s site. Its own terms and privacy practices apply; Kariann does not receive your order information.

Site operation

Displaying and securing the site may involve processing technical data, such as IP addresses and browser information.
